scope: Unbelievable-but-TRUE facts in the style of the Bengali reference channel Mayajaal (mayajaalbangla): unsolved mysteries, discoveries/lost places, world records and unbelievable people, hidden/forbidden places, amazing nature/rare animals, space. English, US audience. NO copying of the reference channel - original scripts and licensed footage only. Every claim must trace to real reporting.

research.exact_search_volume: Only report with named provider and dated evidence. Free trends/news/YouTube signals are proxies, never invented search counts.

cost: Use free sources, Gemini free tier, local Kokoro/ffmpeg, bundled Pexels pool + Wikimedia Commons + Pixabay. No paid APIs, no generate_image. Agent/workflow turns consume Base44 credits.

schedules.rule: OWNER RULE 2026-10-17: one long documentary every 2 days, public 06:30 BD (= US prime evening), produced the previous evening ~20:30 BD. No shorts initially.

production_style.video_tone: Wonder-driven, story-told facts documentary. Cold-open hook, escalating middle, payoff twist in the final third. Original narration (Kokoro am_michael) and own licensed footage. Never reupload or adapt the reference channel's videos, scripts, thumbnails or branding.
production_style.thumbnail_generator: Gemini image API, automatic (PIL fallback). Style: cinematic mystery documentary, dark moody, bold 3-5 word hook text with one gold/red emphasis word.
